messages:
customer_acme_inc: Hey team — since the midnight deploy our autocomplete suggestions are much more random. previously very focused; now a lot of off-topic completions. noticed across multiple users and models. sample payload below.

maria_support: thanks for flagging. can you paste a minimal request + response (obfuscated) and a request id if you have one? we'll triage.

customer_acme_inc: request id: req_0a9f3b2c. curl:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"suggest product names for a fitness app","max_tokens":40}'```response: several completions start talking about recipes and unrelated hobbies.

maria_support: weird. did you pin a model version or using default catalog?

customer_acme_inc: not pinned — using default model route. didn't change our client code.

deploy-bot: @channel deployed: rollout/params-defaults-2026-03-16 03:12 UTC — global default sampling update: temperature 0.9 -> 0.7, top_p 0.95 -> 0.6 (canary 5% earlier today).

maria_support: ah that deploy touched the global sampling defaults for unpinned routes. @tim_ml can you confirm impact?

tim_ml: looking. changing defaults from higher top_p to lower top_p (0.95 -> 0.6) can bias outputs — but typical symptom is less diversity, not more randomness. need to inspect how our post-processing merges beam/ sampling when model is served with specific runtime flags.

liz_sre: I pulled logs for req_0a9f3b2c — runtime shows model rwd-3b#v12, serving params: temperature=0.75, top_p=0.6, continuous_batching=true. note: temperature is 0.75 not 0.7 (some tenant override?), but top_p at 0.6.

aaron_repl: creating escalation ticket INC-2026-224 and putting in P1 — customer impact is production. adding timeline & sample. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

tim_ml: quick hypothesis: when top_p is low AND we have KV-cache warm prefixes, our reranking step that filters by token-probability can promote mid-probability tokens unexpectedly. I can repro locally with a script.

maria_support: any mitigation we can offer the customer now? revert defaults? per-tenant override?

liz_sre: can set a per-route override for their org to restore previous sampling params (temp 0.9, top_p 0.95). I can apply a short-lived rule while eng fixes.

aaron_repl: applied override for org:acme_inc — request_id req_0a9f3b2c now returns focused suggestions. customer confirmed in DM :thumbsup:.

tim_ml: thanks. next steps: 1) root cause confirm (interaction between top_p thresholding + reranker) 2) patch reranker to respect effective sample entropy ordering 3) revert global default until patch lands 4) add unit/regression test.

maria_support: communicated plan to customer and set ETA for revert in 2 hours. they asked for postmortem and safer rollout gating.

tim_ml: I'll open PR with fix and include regression harness using their prompt set. cc @liz_sre for rollout plan.

liz_sre: scheduling a rollback window at 2:00 UTC and will monitor token-level metrics and error rates.

deploy-bot: rollback started: rollout/params-defaults-2026-03-16 -> reverting global sampling defaults to previous values.

customer_acme_inc: update — things look back to normal after the override. appreciate the fast help.

maria_support: filing follow-up eval: add this prompt set to Redwood Optimize checks, and require canary expansion to 20% signal before global flip for sampling defaults.

aaron_repl: closing P1 when PR merges and rollback completes. will attach timeline and notes to INC-2026-224.

maria_support: postmortem reminder: include human-readable summary, root cause (defaults change + reranker interaction), immediate mitigations (per-tenant override + rollback), and long-term action items (tests, canary gating, customer communication template).

tim_ml: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/589 — includes test vectors and explanation.

maria_support: thanks everyone. customer asked for a one-pager on safer defaults; I'll draft and share in #product.

customer_acme_inc: thanks team — great support.
